faqItems.question: What are the eligibility criteria for aviation courses?
faqItems.answer: Most programs require 12th pass (or equivalent). Age limits typically range from 18–25 depending on the course. Share your qualification and we will confirm eligibility for your preferred program.

faqItems.question: Do you provide placement assistance?
faqItems.answer: Yes. We provide placement assistance and career support with strong industry connections. Our team guides students through interviews, grooming, and employer introductions.

faqItems.question: Is there any age limit for cabin crew training?
faqItems.answer: Airline hiring norms often prefer candidates roughly between 18 and 27 years. Our counsellors will advise you based on your profile and the course you choose.

faqItems.question: Do I need prior experience to join?
faqItems.answer: No prior aviation experience is required for most entry-level programs. We train you from fundamentals through practical modules aligned with industry standards.

faqItems.question: Are grooming sessions included?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Grooming, communication, and interview preparation are integrated into our diploma and related modules so students meet airline and hospitality expectations.
